_comment: Ships ONLY a non-blocking SessionStart health check. The enforcing Stop-hook (opt-in ALCOA+ gate) is deferred to a later release. Hooks use EXEC form (command + args, no shell) so a path with spaces needs no quoting; each script starts with a python>=3.8 guard that no-ops with a message. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to this plugin's install location.
